classificationDefinitions.a: Externally published numeric/rule authority. The reducer cases use the explicit Table D300 unity row.
classificationDefinitions.b: Independent hand/reviewer recomputation from the cited formula. It is a self-consistency regression reference, not external numerical validation.

tolerance.justification: All class (b) references are stored at IEEE-754 double precision after an independent calculation pass; 1e-12 permits serialization and operation-order noise but is far below engineering rounding. Class (a) reducer unity values are exact table entries.

commonSources.title: ASME B31.3-2018 Table D300
commonSources.scope: Reducer unity row and Appendix D D/T<=100 general-note context.

reducerDisposition.finding: For the B31.3-2018 Appendix D profile, Table D300 explicitly groups a butt-welded reducer with butt-welded joints and weld-neck flanges and assigns flexibility factor k=1 and stress intensification factor i=1.0. The current legacyReducerFactors() unity result is therefore correct for this edition. It must not be generalized to B31.3-2020+ / B31J.
reducerDisposition.primarySource: ASME B31.3-2018 Table D300, code page 415.
reducerDisposition.independentCorroboration: ASME PVP2023-106810 states that Appendix D specified reducer SIF=1 and that the 2020 B31.3 change to B31J can produce values up to 2.
